faqs.a: justify-content aligns items along the main axis (the flex-direction), while align-items aligns them along the cross axis. With flex-direction: row, justify-content moves items left-right and align-items moves them top-bottom.
faqs.q: What is the difference between justify-content and align-items?

faqs.a: Yes. Click any numbered box to select it, then set its align-self and flex-grow in the Selected item panel. The CSS output gains an .item-N rule with your overrides.
faqs.q: Can I style one item differently?

faqs.a: With flex-wrap: nowrap, items shrink to fit one line and may overflow. With wrap, extra items flow onto new lines. Try 8 items with nowrap versus wrap to feel the difference.
flex-grow distributes leftover space proportionally. With two items at grow 1 and 2, the second gets twice the free space of the first. Set grow 0 to keep an item at its natural size.
space-between pushes the first item to the start and the last to the end; space-around gives each item equal space on both sides; space-evenly makes every gap — including the edges — identical.
faqs.q: What is the difference between space-between, space-around, and space-evenly?

howTo: Pick a flex-direction to set the main axis: row or column.
Choose justify-content for main-axis alignment and align-items for cross-axis.
Toggle flex-wrap and drag the gap slider.
Change the item count between 2 and 8.
Click a box to select it, override its align-self and flex-grow, then copy the CSS.
keyFacts: Flexbox lays out items along one main axis, with an optional cross axis.
flex-direction: row lays out left to right; column lays out top to bottom.
justify-content distributes free space along the main axis.
align-items positions items along the cross axis; stretch is the default.
gap sets spacing between items without margin hacks.

flexbox-playground.quickAnswer: Flexbox is CSS's one-dimensional layout system: a container distributes its items along a main axis, with justify-content controlling main-axis alignment and align-items controlling the cross axis. This playground lets you flip every property live and copy the resulting CSS.
flexbox-playground.tagline: Learn and test CSS flexbox visually, then copy the CSS.
